_comment: CAPABILITY suite for the Db2 CDC stream source with initial_load, over every table of the employees model and its xp_sentinel (functions/caps_db2cdc_initial_load.py::db2cdc_initial_load). The same stages as postgrescdc_initial_load: (1) domains -- create the db2cdc domain, install the employees model, load the xs seed, its operations appended to ${XP_WORK_DIR}/ops.jsonl (--emit-ops) -- as every data command below appends its own; (2) live -- `sentinel-data --key after-create-data`, so the snapshot carries it; (3) collections; (4) functions -- register the @stream_publisher, which STARTS it: with initial_load=True it first emits a snapshot of each tracked table (rows as inserts, a LOAD control row per table ahead of them), then captures changes over the domain's own CD tables (${D0__CD_TABLE_PREFIX}<TABLE>, registered with the model), from the commit sequence the snapshot's brief table lock pinned; asncap stages each change a moment after it commits; (5) sentinel -- hold until after-create-data is in xp_sentinel_changes (the load has flushed); (6) live -- one `modify-data --ops Mix --sets 5` pass, then `sentinel-data --key after-changes`; (7) sentinel -- hold until after-changes has arrived; (8) execute -- scripts/verify_cdc_ops.py checks every <table>_changes against ops.jsonl: the snapshot the state the seed left, the changes after it the operations modify-data applied, one by one, in the same transactions; (9) monitor. db2cdc_initial_load_live is the same with changes running throughout the snapshot. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite container-connectors/db2cdc_initial_load --keep`. verify-ops runs with --cascades logged --noops unlogged, what the Db2 log carries: each row an ON DELETE CASCADE takes arrives in its delete's transaction, and an update setting the values a row has does not arrive. Db2 reports columns upper-cased (EMP_NO), as its catalog folds unquoted names; verify-ops compares them without case.
